note: Diagnosis holds comma lists ('SLE, SjS'); pred's Diagnosis = 'SLE' drops the 'SLE, SjS' exam (aCL IgM 3.1), giving 1.7 instead of 2.2.
Pred additionally requires the exam date to equal the lab date, which no qualifying record satisfies (result NULL); the question asks for all qualifying lab records across all dates.

expense_description holds comma lists ('Water, chips, cookies'); pred counts distinct descriptions (5) instead of distinct items (Sacha has 7: Posters, Water, chips, cookies, Pizza, Alumni Glass, Travel Mug), creating a false tie.
Admission has values '+' and '+(' ; evidence says inpatient regardless of extra detail, but pred uses Admission = '+', missing '+(' patients.
Unique elements in '+' molecules are zn (TR238), cu (TR430), y (TR499); question asks for all bonds of those molecules, pred returns only bonds touching the unique-element atom via connected.
q1 is text; pred's string comparison q1 > '2:00.000' misses '16:42.640' (lexically smaller), so 9 instead of 10.
Gold sums sets.totalSetSize (793); pred counts card rows in those sets (808: AKH has 302 rows vs totalSetSize 287). 'How many cards were there across the sets' supports both.
Same pit stop and track; pred returns milliseconds (2011266) instead of the duration string '33:31.266'. Same quantity, different representation.
There are two events named 'Football game'; pred counts attendance rows, so a member attending both is counted twice (Elementary Education 3 vs 2 distinct members).

Pred takes each season's final-round standings only, losing seasons where a constructor has no row in the last race; gold uses each constructor's last standings row per year (Ferrari 6618.5 vs 6991.5).
Pred's inner join drops Aaron players with 0 matches; question asks for every qualifying player (gold LEFT JOIN shows Appindangoye 0, Doran 0).

Gold groups by the full type line (`type`, e.g. 'Creature — Human Soldier'), fragmenting creatures so 'Instant' (28) wins; in MTG 'card type' is the `types` column (catalog: 'all card types of the card'), where Creature has 71. Pred's answer is the better one.
CDSCode is text with a leading zero ('01612590125716'); pred compares to '1612590125716' so the county lookup returns NULL and everything is empty. Gold casts to integer.
Pred checks card-level foreign_data instead of set_translations (set names); returns many FTV sets that do have translated set names.

Colours among ids 1-20 are W and B; gold counts formats for those 20 cards only, pred counts formats for all cards of that colour. 'number of play formats in which cards of that color are legal' admits both.
colour table has no 'Unknown'; the unknown category is 'No Colour'. Pred's literal returns 0 rows.
3 Marvel heroes with powers have a missing/invalid alignment_id; pred's inner join drops them from the denominator (64.97 vs 64.39).
originalReleaseDate is stored as '2014/12/2'; strftime returns NULL on that format so pred counts 0. Gold uses substr.
Gold keeps eye colours with zero non-brown-haired heroes (Blue/White, 0); pred's inner join/WHERE drops zero-count rows although the question asks for every eye colour.
U-PRO values are '3','4','300','>=1000'; pred looks for '3+'/'4+' (nonexistent) and its GLOB excludes '>=1000', so it misses patients.
Pred reads 'have single bonds' as 'only single bonds' (NOT EXISTS non-single) and returns nothing; gold's 'has at least one single bond' is the natural reading.
Pred omits rtype = 'S', so a district-level SAT row (School NULL) has the max and the answer is NULL.
Pred takes every set released on the max date (adds PUMA, which lacks the card) instead of only sets containing Ancestor's Chosen: 29 vs 25.
Question demands round-half-away-from-zero on the exact mean; pred's float ROUND(AVG/1000,2) gives 11061.58 for 1952 where the exact half rounds to 11061.59.
85 qualifying 2010 posts have no matching owner user; pred's inner join drops them, though they were not made by high-reputation users (30.73 vs 33.44).
Pred excludes any diagnosis containing 'susp' (e.g. 'SLE, SJS susp', 'SLE, APS susp' where SLE is confirmed); evidence says only the suspected disease is excluded.
Pred uses Diagnosis = 'SLE' (misses comma lists) and counts exam rows rather than distinct patients (33.33 vs 57.14).
CDSCode text has a leading zero; pred's '1611430131177' matches nothing so the result is empty.
satscores.cds has a leading zero; pred's '7618040730051' subquery returns NULL so the count is 0.
originalReleaseDate uses 'YYYY/MM/DD'; strftime returns NULL so pred's sum is NULL (gold 4.0 via substr).
Question explicitly asks for the text as one line; pred returns the raw text with an embedded newline.
RNP is text ('negative','0','16',...); pred's L.RNP > 4 compares text to a number, which is always true in SQLite, so 'negative' results are included.
CDS code literal lacks the leading zero, so no row matches; pred also uses schools.FundingType instead of frpm's Charter Funding Type.
RNP is text; MAX(RNP) is 'negative' lexically, so pred picks negative tests instead of the numeric max 256 (gold casts to REAL).
Pred restricts standing orders to k_symbol = 'SIPO' (3,502 of 6,471 orders); the `order` table is the standing-order table and the question counts all its debits (5298.02 vs 3588.91).
